description: How crowded is an idea space over time? Counts projects (and how many of them won a prize) per year whose pitch contains ALL of the given keywords. Use it to show trends such as 'study-buddy chatbots exploded after 2023'. Pass 2-4 plain keywords as `keywords` (e.g. 'flashcards quiz pdf'); every keyword must match, so fewer keywords = broader count. Returns year, projects, winners.

configuration.query: FROM {{INDEX}} | WHERE MATCH(pitch, ?keywords, {"operator": "AND"}) | STATS projects = COUNT(*), winners = COUNT(*) WHERE is_winner == true BY year | SORT year

keywords.description: 2-4 keywords that must ALL appear in the project pitch, space separated.
